degenerateReason: A string function over a non-string operand is a CEL type error that denies every seed. A store coercing the number to text would return rows.
intent: startsWith() called on a numeric attribute (R.attr.aNumber.startsWith("2")).
trap: A string function on a non-string receiver is a CEL error; LIKE '2%' over the number coerced to text returns rows.
